5:46.text: And in their footsteps, We sent ‘Îsâ
that had come before him, and We gave him the Injeel
, in which was guidance and light and confirmation of the Taurât
that had come before it, a guidance and an admonition for Al-Muttaqûn

5:47.text: Let the people of the Injeel
judge by what Allâh has revealed therein. And whosoever does not judge by what Allâh has revealed
[the rebellious i.e. disobedient (of a lesser degree)]

5:48.text: And We have sent down to you
in truth, confirming the Scripture that came before it and Muhaymin

. So judge among them by what Allâh has revealed, and follow not their vain desires, diverging away from the truth that has come to you. To each among you, We have prescribed a law and a clear way. If Allâh had willed, He would have made you one nation, but that
may test you in what He has given you; so compete in good deeds. The return of you
is to Allâh; then He will inform you about that in which you used to differ.

5:49.text: (you O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
among them by what Allâh has revealed and follow not their vain desires, but beware of them lest they turn you
far away from some of that which Allâh has sent down to you. And if they turn away, then know that Allâh’s Will is to punish them for some sins of theirs. And truly, most of men are Fâsiqûn

5:50.text: Do they then seek the judgement of
And who is better in judgement than Allâh for a people who have firm Faith.
